tables.name: Orders
tables.grain: one row per order; amount at order grain

tables.name: Items
tables.grain: one row per item; order_id foreign key

measures.name: amount
measures.basis: The Orders-to-Items join is one-to-many, so an order amount can repeat for each matching book item; no approved deduplication rule is supplied.

sequence: Join Orders to Items on order_id.
risks: Order rows may be repeated by multiple qualifying Items rows, causing structural duplication.
No observed numerical error or overcount is inferred.
alternatives: Supported: create a distinct qualifying order_id set using a semi-join, then aggregate Orders.amount by region.
Conditional: aggregate Orders before joining only if the intended matching semantics and resulting entity set are confirmed.
